note: Explore the City (Playtest v1.10, pp. 147–150): the exploration table (d66) and the finds it leads to. An action is `gold` – a number or dice such as `d6x5` –, `table` – a roll on the Curiosities or Relics table or one of `tables` below –, `blackRot` and `experience` – levels or points a fighter gains, below 0 taken away –, `injury_roll`, `wargear`, `holding`, `recruit`, `remove`, or `party`: what falls on each fighter of the scouting party that carries one of `keywords` and none of `except`, by the d6 each rolls, or all alike without `dice`. `byHand` marks what the app does not keep.

rows.name: Reliquary
rows.text: You find 2d6 silver. In addition, roll once on the Curiosity table.

rows.name: Saint's Tomb
rows.text: You find d6x5 silver. In addition, roll once on the Relics table.

encounters.name: Danger Lies Ahead…
encounters.text:
Down a darkened alleyway, you spy shadows ahead. Perhaps it is a rival warband also searching this part of the City, perhaps something worse. You must decide how to proceed.

**Confront them Head On:** Roll a dice for each fighter in the scouting party and total the score. If the total is 15 or more, you drive off the assailants and are victorious: each fighter earns 5 experience. Otherwise you are defeated: roll a dice for each fighter, and on a 1–2 make an injury roll for them.

**Attempt to Sneak Past:** Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or greater than the number of fighters in the scouting party, you sneak past and roll on the Curiosity table. Otherwise you are detected: roll a dice for each fighter, and on a 1 make an injury roll for them.

**Turn Back:** The scouting party returns empty handed.

encounters.name: Dead-end
encounters.text: The trail goes cold. You find nothing of note this night. The scouting party returns empty handed.

encounters.name: Crossroads
encounters.text: Divide the scouting party into 2 groups as evenly as possible. Then make a new exploration roll for each group, treating each group as its own scouting party. You can use exploration re-rolls with either group unless they are granted for a specific fighter. Any further rolls of Crossroads are ignored: the scouting party returns empty handed instead.

encounters.name: A Curious Find
encounters.text: As you pass through the husk of a burnt-out ruin, a glimmer in the dark catches your eye. Roll on the Curiosity table.

encounters.name: Swarm of Rats
encounters.text:
A distant thrum of chittering grows louder by the second. **Battle the Swarm:** roll once on the table below for each fighter in the scouting party.

**Brethren to the Verminkin:** Verminkin warbands ignore this result and re-roll the exploration roll instead.

encounters.name: A Shallow Grave
encounters.text:
You find a recently dug grave in the courtyard of an old manor house. There may be something of value buried below.

**Exhume the Grave:** Roll a d6. Add 1 to the result if the scouting party includes any Priests. 1–2 Rotten Remains: each fighter in the scouting party gains 1 level of Black Rot. 3–5 Buried Silver: you find d6x5 silver. 6+ Grave Offerings: you find 2d6x5 silver and roll once on the Curiosity table.

**Turn Back:** The scouting party returns empty handed.

encounters.name: Quiet Night
encounters.text: You search this district high and low, but on this night the City is quiet and you find nothing of note. The scouting party returns empty handed.

encounters.name: Leech Pools
encounters.text:
You descend a set of cobblestone steps down to one of the City's many canals. Here the waters teem with thousands of writhing leeches.

**Bathe:** You can remove 1 level of Black Rot from each fighter in the scouting party.

**Harvest:** Roll a dice for each non-Beast fighter in the scouting party. For each 4+, you receive 1 Jar of Canal Leeches.

encounters.name: The Belfry
encounters.text: Amidst the rubble and ruins, an old belfry stands in defiance. You can pick 1 non-Beast fighter in the scouting party to scale the belfry. If you do so, roll a dice. On a 1 the fighter falls: make an injury roll for them. On a 2+, add their Initiative value to the dice roll to create a climbing score. You receive each result that the climbing score equals or exceeds: 6+ Gargoyle Eyes, you receive d6x2 silver. 8+ Vantage Point, you can make an additional exploration roll for the scouting party; any further rolls of The Belfry are ignored and the scouting party returns empty handed instead. 10+ The Top, roll on the Curiosity table.

who.note: The fighter who scales the belfry.

ask.label: Roll a dice and add the fighter's Initiative

encounters.name: A Hidden Stash
encounters.text: Hidden between the floorboards of a two-storied town house, you discover a stash of valuables left behind by its former occupants. You find 2d6x5 silver. In addition, roll on the Curiosity table.

encounters.name: Secluded Holding
encounters.text: Down a twisting side street flanked by ruined towers that cast long shadows, you come across a building that has thus far escaped the ravages of war and plague. Roll once on the Holdings table. You can take control of that holding. Re-roll results of Ruined Hovel until you get a different result.

encounters.name: Hunted in Darkness…
encounters.text: Put the fighters in the scouting party in an order of your choosing, and then begin rolling a dice for each fighter one at a time, in order. If you roll a 1 for a fighter they are lost in the dark and you stop rolling dice: the fighter is killed.

ask.label: Roll a dice for each fighter in order

options.label: A 1 rolled – lost in the dark

encounters.name: A Treasure Horde
encounters.text: You find a latched trapdoor hidden beneath the debris of a ruined house. After breaking the lock, you discover a large stash of silver coins in the compartment below. For each non-Beast fighter in the scouting party, you find d6x5 silver.

encounters.name: Hallowed Ground
encounters.text:
Hidden amongst the ruins you discover a small chapel untouched by the Black Rot. Roll a dice on the table to see what you find. Then pick 1 of the options.

**Take Sanctuary (Guild Mercenaries only):** Roll a dice for each fighter in the scouting party. On a 4+ you can remove 1 injury or 1 level of Black Rot from that fighter.

**Exhume Graves (Death Covens only):** Roll a dice for each fighter in the scouting party. If you roll any 6s, you can recruit a Skeleton Warrior or Zombie to your warband for 0 silver.

**Desecrate:** Leaders or Champions in the scouting party earn 10 experience. Each other fighter in the scouting party earns d6 experience.

encounters.name: Into the Catacombs…
encounters.text:
After searching extensively through the ruins you at last discover what you have been seeking: a hidden stairwell leading down to the catacombs below. Start rolling dice, one at a time, and keep a total of the score. Stop when you roll a 1, or the total is 10 or more (whichever happens first), then consult the table.

**Leader's Intuition:** If your scouting party includes your warband's Leader, you can re-roll the first roll of 1.

ask.label: The score where the rolling stopped
